events.title: Rheingau Musik Festival – Konzerte (bis 5. September)
events.description: The Rheingau Musik Festival continues its summer season of 158 concerts at 26 venues across the Rheingau and Wiesbaden until 5 September. Programmes range from orchestral evenings at Kloster Eberbach's Basilica to intimate chamber recitals at Schloss Vollrads and the Kurhaus Wiesbaden.

events.title: Wasserspiele im Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe (Kassel)
events.description: The world-famous water features of the UNESCO Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe run every Wednesday, Saturday, Sunday and public holiday from 1 May to 3 October. The grand cascade, spring and water dance create a spectacular baroque water theatre in Kassel's landmark park.

events.title: Wochenmarkt Wiesbaden auf dem Dern'schen Gelände
events.description: The Wiesbaden weekly market on the Dern'sches Gelände takes place every Wednesday and Saturday, offering fresh produce, regional specialities, flowers and artisan goods. A lively central market that runs year-round (twice weekly).

events.title: Rheingau Musik Festival – Late Season Concerts (Eltville/Wiesbaden)
events.description: Europe's largest privately funded music festival (158 concerts at 26 venues) enters its final weeks. Late-season concerts play in atmospheric settings like the Basilica of Kloster Eberbach, Schloss Johannisberg and the Kurhaus Wiesbaden, with world-class soloists and orchestras. The festival runs until 5 September.

events.title: European Elvis Festival Bad Nauheim
events.description: An homage to Elvis Presley, who lived in Bad Nauheim in the late 1950s. Fans gather for a weekend of Rock'n'Roll with concerts by Elvis tribute artists, a parade, vintage cars and a festive town atmosphere across several venues. Runs 14-16 August 2026.

events.title: Rheingauer Weinwoche (Wiesbaden)
events.description: The world's largest Riesling tasting: ten days from 14-23 August turn the Wiesbaden centre around Marktkirche, Schlossplatz and Dern'sches Gelände into one big wine bar with over 100 wine stands and gourmet food stalls. Live music on multiple stages every evening.
events.cost_per_person: Free entry; wine tasting from ~5 EUR/glass

events.title: Rüdesheimer Weinfest 'Summer of Riesling'
events.description: The idyllic old town of Rüdesheim hosts winemakers pouring young Riesling, smooth Spätburgunder and rare vintages in the famous Drosselgasse and along the river front, with live music and regional gastronomy. Runs 14-17 August 2026.

events.title: Sommernachts-Open-Air mit dem Staatsorchester Kassel
events.description: The Kassel State Orchestra under General Music Director Ainārs Rubiķis performs an open-air programme of popular classical melodies on the Karlswiese at the edge of the Karlsaue park. A summery pick-nick style concert under the stars.

events.title: Stadtfest Gießen
events.description: On the third August weekend the Gießen city centre becomes a big open-air stage with live bands on many podiums, culinary stands and a varied children's programme. The festive Sunday (16 Aug) features an extended programme through the streets.

events.title: Amphitheater Hanau – Open-Air-Konzerte im Spätsommer
events.description: After the Brüder Grimm Festspiele season, from late summer through autumn the Amphitheater in the park of Schloss Philippsruhe hosts concerts, solo artists, comedians and cultural acts under an open sky. The covered stage in the park runs until early October.

events.title: Open-Air-Kino & Kulturprogramm im Hafen 2 (Offenbach)
events.description: The cultural centre Hafen 2 in Offenbach hosts open-air cinema evenings and concerts on the harbour quay during the summer weeks. Behind the industrial-chic venue, films, live music and DJ sets bring the Mainhafen to life on warm evenings.

events.title: Wiesenflimmern – Open-Air-Filmfestival Fulda (Streuobstwiese)
events.description: The Wiesenflimmern open-air film festival screens short films and a main feature on an idyllic orchard meadow in Niederrode near Fulda, paired with live music and regional treats. After dark the old fruit trees are colourfully illuminated. Season runs through September.

events.title: Open-Air-Kino Marburg – Schlossparkbühne
events.description: Marburg's open-air cinema on the Schlossparkbühne shows films on several evenings per week beneath the illuminated Landgrafenschloss until 5 September. Current films and classics in a unique castle atmosphere; bring a blanket, cinema snack concessions available.

events.title: Kultursommer Nordhessen – Konzertreihe (Kassel & Region)
events.description: The Kultursommer Nordhessen, Hessen's oldest summer festival season (since 1988), continues in August with concerts spanning chamber music, symphonic, a cappella and entertainment in Kassel and the wider region through mid/late August. Each date features a different ensemble.

events.title: HandmadeART Kunsthandwerksmarkt Hofheim am Taunus (Fortsetzung)
events.description: The HandmadeART arts-and-crafts market in Hofheim's historic centre showcases artisans, artists and designers with handmade goods, plus a children's workshop programme. The market continues through August with a family-friendly, creative atmosphere.

events.title: Kassel: Black is Beautiful – Summer Open Air (Fortsetzung)
events.description: The 'Black is Beautiful' series brings soul, R&B and hip-hop open-air concerts to venues in and around Kassel during August. A celebration of Black music culture on outdoor stages during the summer season.

events.title: WDC 2026 – Hafen 26 'Zukünfte gestalten' (Offenbach)
events.description: As part of World Design Capital 2026 (Frankfurt & Offenbach), the Hochschule für Gestaltung Offenbach presents 'Hafen 26 – Zukünfte gestalten', a programme of exhibitions, talks and workshops imagining future-living concepts. Runs through the summer at the harbour quarter.

events.title: Fulda Open-Air-Kino Sommer (verschiedene Locations)
events.description: Fulda and surroundings host open-air cinema screenings on summer evenings through September, from the Wiesenflimmern orchard festival to courtyard and park screenings. Films run under the open sky with local refreshments.

events.title: Marburg Abendliche Altstadt & Marktplatz-Konzerte
events.description: Marburg's lively university-town old town offers informal evening concerts and open-air music on the Marktplatz and near the Landgrafenschloss during the summer. Street cafés, half-timbered lanes and the castle above create a special ambience into early autumn.

events.title: Werra-Meißner: Kesperkirmes-Nachklang & Wochenmärkte (Witzenhausen/Eschwege)
events.description: The weekly markets of the Werra-Meißner district towns (Witzenhausen, Eschwege) continue through late summer, selling regional produce, fruit from local orchards and handicrafts. A taste of north-east Hessen country life.

events.title: Johannes Oerding – Sommer Open Air Kassel
events.description: German singer-songwriter Johannes Oerding brings his summery pop-rock open-air show to the Karlswiese near the Karlsaue. Known for hits like 'Kreise' and 'Blinde Passagiere', he draws large friendly crowds.

events.title: Schloss Johannisberg & Schloss Vollrads – RMF Wein- und Konzertabende
events.description: Two of the Rheingau's most famous wine estates host Rheingau Musik Festival concerts and wine-paired evenings in August: Schloss Johannisberg (Fürst-von-Metternich-Saal) and Schloss Vollrads. Enjoy fine music with premier Rheingau Riesling in grand historic settings.

events.title: Herkules-Plattform & Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe – Welterbe-Erlebnis
events.description: The Herkules monument and the UNESCO World Heritage Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe are open to visitors for spectacular views over Kassel. The octagonal palace with the giant statue, fountains and baroque park is a must-see backdrop during the water-feature runs until 3 October.

events.title: Bad Nauheim Sprudelhof & Konzertsonntage
events.description: Bad Nauheim's Jugendstil Sprudelhof and Kurpark host Sunday concert afternoons during the summer season, with light classical and entertainment music. Combine a stroll through the art-nouveau spa grounds with a relaxing live-music matinee.

events.title: Hanau – Brüder Grimm Festspiele Ausklang & Amphitheater-Programm
events.description: The Brüder Grimm Festspiele at Hanau's Amphitheater transition into the late-summer cultural programme at Schloss Philippsruhe. Family-friendly theatre, concerts and shows continue in the park and the covered open-air stage into autumn.

events.title: Bad Hersfeld: Stiftsruine & Festspiel-Nachklang/Kulturszene
events.description: After the 75th Bad Hersfelder Festspiele (26 June-16 Aug), the monumental Stiftsruine remains open for visitors and the town's cultural programme continues with concerts and exhibitions at venues including the Stadthalle during the autumn.

events.title: Limburg Wochenmarkt am Dom
events.description: Limburg a. d. Lahn's weekly market takes place in the shadow of the cathedral, offering regional food, flowers and crafts. A lovely chance to experience the historic Dom- und Altstadt atmosphere on market morning.

events.title: Wiesbaden Kurpark & Kochbrunnen – Sommerkonzerte
events.description: Wiesbaden's Kurpark offers free summer concert mornings around the Kochbrunnen and Kursaal. Light classical and entertainment music in the spa park provide a relaxed high-cultural Sunday start in the state capital.

events.title: Fulda Wochenmarkt auf dem Uniplatz
events.description: Fulda's open-air weekly market on the Uniplatz runs throughout the year (Tuesdays and Saturdays), offering fresh regional produce, baked goods, flowers and seasonal specialities in front of the university. A lively market tradition in the baroque city.

events.title: Kassel Wochenmarkt am Friedrichsplatz
events.description: Kassel's weekly market at Friedrichsplatz opposite the Fridericianum takes place on Saturdays throughout the year, offering regional produce, flowers and food stalls in the shadow of the documenta landmark building.

events.title: Friedberg Burg & Wochenmarkt
events.description: Friedberg in the Wetterau hosts a Saturday weekly market in the pedestrian zone below the medieval Burgfried. Regional produce and handicrafts with the imperial-castle town's historic backdrop.

events.title: Rheingau Wochenmarkt & Winzerstube Rüdesheim
events.description: Rüdesheim's market and the surrounding Rheingau wine villages offer Saturday-morning winzerstuben (wine taverns) and produce markets into autumn. Sample the season's young wine (Federweißer) with regional bread and cheese along the Rhine.

events.title: Hofheim Wochenmarkt & Altstadt
events.description: Hofheim am Taunus's weekly market in the town centre offers fresh produce and local specialities. Combine shopping with a walk through the half-timbered Altstadt of the Main-Taunus district capital.

events.title: Wetzlar Wochenmarkt & Altstadtbummel
events.description: Wetzlar's Saturday weekly market in the old town (Altstadt) brings regional food and crafts to the half-timbered lanes below the cathedral. A relaxed market morning in the historic Lahn town.

events.title: Offenbach Wochenmarkt & Büsingpark-Spaziergang
events.description: Offenbach's central market and the adjacent Büsingpark (Berufspark) offer weekend produce stalls and a green escape near the station. The park also hosts open-air cultural events during the summer season.

events.title: Bad Homburg Kurpark & Kurgarten-Konzerte
events.description: Bad Homburg's Kurpark offers open-air concert matinees in summer, with light classical and spa-band music in the gardens of the health resort. The Schlossberg with its medieval castle overlooks the scene.
events.location: Kurpark, 61348 Bad Homburg v. d. Höhe

events.title: Darmstadt Wochenmarkt auf dem Marktplatz
events.description: Darmstadt's long-established Saturday market on the Marktplatz offers regional produce, flowers and specialities beneath the historic Rathaus and the 'Langer Lulatsch' tower. A city-centre tradition.

events.title: Hanau Wochenmarkt am Marktplatz
events.description: Hanau's weekly market on the Marktplatz offers fresh regional produce and flowers. In the birthplace of the Brothers Grimm, a morning market also invites a stroll through the historic centre.

events.title: Bergstraße Winzer & Weinfeste Wochenenden (Heppenheim/Bensheim)
events.description: The Hessische Bergstraße wine villages (Heppenheim, Bensheim and others) host weekend wine events and open winery terraces from late summer into October, with young wine, regional food and live music beneath the Schlossberge.

events.title: Eltville Wochenmarkt am Rossert & Rheinufer
events.description: Eltville am Rhein, the 'wine town' of the Rheingau, hosts a Saturday market with regional wine and produce near the Kurfürstliche Burg and along the Rhine. Historic half-timbered streets complete the visit.

events.title: Gießen Wochenmarkt auf dem Kirchenplatz
events.description: Gießen's weekly market on the Kirchenplatz takes place several days a week and offers regional food and produce. A convenient market stop in the university town's centre.

events.title: Rüsselsheim Wochenmarkt
events.description: Rüsselsheim am Main's weekly market offers regional produce and specialities in the town centre. A straightforward local market in the city at the confluence of Main and Rhine.

events.title: Eschwege Wochenmarkt & Altstadt
events.description: Eschwege in the Werra-Meißner district hosts a weekly market with regional produce in its historic half-timbered old town. A pleasant market morning in north-east Hessen.

events.title: Wiesbaden Kurhaus – Rheingau Musik Festival Konzertabend
events.description: The grand Friedrich-von-Thiersch-Saal of the Kurhaus Wiesbaden hosts a Rheingau Musik Festival concert evening with international soloists. Eleganz architecture and first-class classical music combine for a festive summer night.

events.title: Gießener Kultursommer – Eröffnungskonzert (Philharmonisches Orchester)
events.description: The Gießen Kultursommer opens at the beautiful open-air stage of Kloster Schiffenberg with the Philharmonic Orchestra of the Stadttheater Gießen. The festival runs 19-30 August with 13 concerts across pop, rock and classical genres.

events.title: Gießener Kultursommer – James Arthur
events.description: British superstar James Arthur headlines the Gießen Kultursommer at the scenic open-air stage of Kloster Schiffenberg, performing hits like 'Say You Won't Let Go'. The medieval monastery ruins provide a unique concert backdrop.

events.title: Stadtfest Fulda
events.description: Four days (20-23 Aug) turn the Fulda city centre into a festival mile between Bonifatiusplatz, Universitätsplatz and Schlosspark. Live music of all styles, shows and hands-on activities on several stages; opening act is local cult band Mambo KingX. Free entry.

events.title: Rheingauer Weinwoche – Wein- und Musikabende (Wiesbaden)
events.description: Mid-way through the ten-day Rheingauer Weinwoche, the Wiesbaden wine mile around Marktkirche and Schlossplatz peaks with evening live-music performances and extended tasting hours. The world's largest Riesling tasting runs 14-23 August.

events.title: Gießener Kultursommer – Donots & H-Blockx
events.description: German punk-rock veterans Donots and H-Blockx share the open-air stage at Kloster Schiffenberg as part of the Gießen Kultursommer, delivering a high-energy evening of rock anthems. Doors open at 18:00.

events.title: Holy Vibes Festival Gießen
events.description: A one-day festival at the Kloster Schiffenberg open-air venue in Gießen with electronic and club culture acts. Part of the region's summer festival programme, attracting a young crowd for an evening of DJ sets and live music amidst the monastery ruins.

events.title: Mallorca Sommer Festival Marburg
events.description: A party event in Marburg with summer hit energy: live acts and party music transform the Schlossparkbühne into a Mediterranean-style fiesta for a night of dancing and celebration. Popular with a lively crowd who come to sing and party.

events.title: Gießener Kultursommer – Howard Carpendale
events.description: German pop and schlager legend Howard Carpendale performs at the Kloster Schiffenberg open-air stage during the Gießen Kultursommer. Fans enjoy his evergreen hits in the unique atmosphere of the monastery ruins.

events.title: Ausstellungsschiff MS Wissenschaft in Rüsselsheim
events.description: The floating science lab MS Wissenschaft docks in Rüsselsheim (24-27 Aug) as part of its Germany tour. The hands-on exhibition on board invites visitors of all ages to explore current research topics through interactive stations. Free entry.

events.title: Gießener Kultursommer – Nena
events.description: German pop icon Nena, known worldwide for '99 Luftballons', performs at the open-air Kloster Schiffenberg stage. Her timeless new-wave pop and lively stage presence are a highlight of the Gießen Kultursommer.

events.title: Gießener Kultursommer – Uriah Heep
events.description: British rock legends Uriah Heep bring their classic hard rock to the Kloster Schiffenberg open-air stage for the Gießen Kultursommer, celebrating decades of hits like 'Easy Livin'' and 'July Morning'.

events.title: Weinfest Fulda im Schlosshof
events.description: From 26 August to 5 September the Fulda castle courtyard (Schlosshof) becomes the city's place to be for wine lovers, with regional and international wines, live music every evening and a convivial square atmosphere. Open Wednesday to Saturday, 17:00-midnight.
events.cost_per_person: Free entry; tasting tokens from ~5 EUR

events.title: Mosburgfest im Schlosspark Biebrich (Wiesbaden)
events.description: The traditional Mosburgfest in the park of Schloss Biebrich in Wiesbaden (28-30 Aug) combines a festive village atmosphere with live music, food stalls and rides for the whole family in the baroque palace grounds. Organised by the Gibber Kerbegesellschaft.

events.title: Kassel: Kunst- und Theater-Jahrmarkt auf dem Papinplatz
events.description: A cross-disciplinary art and theatre fair opens the 2026/27 season at Staatstheater Kassel (28 Aug - 6 Sep) on the bus parking lot at Papinplatz. Performances, installations and hands-on activities bring the arts into public space next to the Schauspielhaus.

events.title: Gießener Kultursommer – Kool Savas & Haftbefehl
events.description: Hip-hop heavyweights come together at the Kloster Schiffenberg stage for a night of German rap as part of the Gießen Kultursommer. Two of the scene's most influential artists share the open-air bill.

events.title: Weinfest Fulda – Live-Musikabende im Schlosshof
events.description: The Weinfest Fulda's August weekend in the Schlosshof brings special live-music performances alongside the wine stands. Part of the festival running 26 August - 5 September (Wed-Sat, 17:00-midnight).
events.cost_per_person: Free entry; tasting tokens from ~5 EUR

events.title: Gießener Kultursommer – MEUTE & weitere Acts
events.description: The final days of the Gießen Kultursommer bring techno-brass sensation MEUTE to the Kloster Schiffenberg open-air stage, closing a 13-concert festival (19-30 Aug) that also featured Amy Macdonald, Wincent Weiss and Kings of Rap across the season.

events.title: Darmstädter Weinfest
events.description: Darmstadt's wine festival (3-6 Sep) on the Marktplatz celebrates the region's wine tradition with winemakers, food stands and live music, culminating in a verkaufsoffener Sonntag (open shopping Sunday). The organ concert 'Im Rausch der Klänge' takes place in St. Ludwig on Saturday 5 Sep.

events.title: Riviera Festival Offenbach
events.description: Three days (4-6 Sep) of pop and club culture at Offenbach's Mainufer as part of World Design Capital 2026. Newcomers meet established scene stars of indie, rap, electro, post-punk and pop, with concerts, readings and long nights of dancing across several venues.

events.title: Brückenfest Wetzlar
events.description: Wetzlar's combined city festival and 25th bridge run (4-6 Sep) spans the town's famous Lahbrücken. The programme blends sporting highlights, city-fest flair, live music and a lively supporting programme around the historic bridges and old town.

events.title: Herbstzauber in der Karlsaue (Kassel)
events.description: The autumn garden and plant market in Kassel's Karlsaue park and on the Blumeninsel Siebenbergen (4-6 Sep) presents colourful autumn flowers, rare plants and beautiful things for house and garden. A feast for garden lovers in the historic park setting.

events.title: Kasseler Museumsnacht
events.description: Around 50 museums, galleries and cultural institutions across Kassel open their doors late into the night for the annual Museumsnacht under the motto 'Teilhabe'. A special programme of exhibitions, music, tours and performances links the city's cultural highlights. Buses connect the venues.

events.title: Langener Kerb
events.description: The traditional Langen Kerb falls on the first September weekend this year (5-8 Sep). Classic fair programme with rides, festival tent, food stalls and a family day in the town of Langen in the Offenbach district.

events.title: Bergsträßer Winzerfest Bensheim
events.description: South Hesse's largest wine festival (5-13 Sep, since 1929) draws around 100,000 visitors to Bensheim's historic market place and old town. Winemakers from the Hessische Bergstraße pour their wines to live music, with the festival parade as a highlight.

events.title: Wiesbaden Open-Air Flohmarkt am Schlachthof
events.description: The start of the open-air flea market season at the Kulturzentrum Schlachthof Wiesbaden. Browse stalls with vintage treasures, second-hand goods and quirky finds in a lively cultural setting on Murnaustraße.

events.title: Ausstellung 'Verheißungsvoll' – Schloss Wilhelmshöhe Kassel (letzter Tag)
events.description: The special exhibition 'Verheißungsvoll – Bilder von Kosmos und Hoffnung' at Schloss Wilhelmshöhe concludes on 6 September. It explores humanity's fascination with the afterlife and hope across centuries through paintings, graphics and objects in the West Hesse State Museum's collection.

events.title: Kassel: 'Offene Werkstatt' im documenta archiv
events.description: The documenta archiv in Kassel offers open-workshop days and guided looks behind the scenes of the documents of modern and contemporary art. A behind-the-curtains insight into the archive institution in the run-up to documenta 16.

events.title: Darmstädter Weinfest – Finale mit verkaufsoffenem Sonntag
events.description: Final day of the Darmstädter Weinfest (3-6 Sep) with the open shopping Sunday in the city centre. Wine stands and live music round off the long festival weekend on the Marktplatz.

events.title: Beleuchtete Wasserspiele im Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe (Kassel)
events.description: The world-famous illuminated water features of the UNESCO Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe (11-12 Sep) turn the cascades, aqueduct and Grand Fountain into a nocturnal spectacle with atmospheric supporting programme. Thousands gather each year for this highlight. Free entry.

events.title: KjG Open Air Kino Darmstadt
events.description: The Katholische junge Gemeinde (KjG) hosts an open-air cinema evening at Heilig Kreuz Darmstadt, screening a film under the open sky. Bring a blanket and snacks for a cosy late-summer movie night.

events.title: Weinfest Limburg
events.description: The Limburg-Weilburg district's family-friendly Weinfest in Limburg an der Lahn (12 Sep) pours regional wines and offers a relaxed programme in the town's historic setting. A convivial event in the shadow of Limburg Cathedral.

events.title: Heppenheim Altstadtkunst & Weingenuss Wochenenden
events.description: Throughout late summer Heppenheim's historic old town hosts wine-tasting weekends with the wineries of the Hessische Bergstraße, live music and galleries open in the half-timbered lanes below Starkenburg Castle. Regional wine and culinary specialities in an idyllic setting.

events.title: Darmstadt Mathildenhöhe – Ausstellungen im Herbst
events.description: Museum Künstlerkolonie and the exhibitions on Darmstadt's Mathildenhöhe (Jugendstil art-nouveau UNESCO site) present changing special exhibitions through autumn. The iconic wedding tower and the artists' colony make a cultural day out.

events.title: Bergsträßer Winzerfest Bensheim – Winzerfestumzug
events.description: The famous Bergsträßer Winzerfest parade rolls through Bensheim's old town on the festival weekend (festival runs 5-13 Sep), with decorated floats, winery wagons, marching bands and traditional costumes in front of up to 100,000 visitors.

events.title: Schwimmende Weinprobe Rüdesheim
events.description: A unique floating wine tasting on the Rhine: a two-hour castle cruise (Burgenrundfahrt) with four wine samples, a pretzel and an exclusive Rüdesheim wine glass to keep. A lovely way to enjoy the Rheingau from the water. Organised by Rüd-Tourist AG.

events.title: Kassel Staatstheater – Saisoneröffnung & INTERIM 'Aida' Vorpremiere
events.description: Staatstheater Kassel opens its 2026/27 season with a focus on Mozart before premiering Verdi's 'Aida' in the new INTERIM auditorium later in October. The season opening on 13 September presents the ensemble and incoming music director.

events.title: Friedberger Herbstmarkt
events.description: The 74th Friedberg autumn market (18-21 Sep) takes place at the Seewiese, with rides, food and drink stalls and fair atmosphere. A regional autumn fair visitable on foot within 10-15 minutes from Friedberg train station.

events.title: Friedberger Herbstmarkt – Abschlusstag
events.description: Closing day of the 74th Friedberger Herbstmarkt (18-21 Sep) at the Seewiese, with a final round of rides, food stalls and fairground atmosphere before the autumn fair packs away.

events.title: Wiesbadener Stadtfest, Erntedankfest & Herbstmarkt
events.description: Wiesbaden's big city festival (25-27 Sep) combines a Herbstmarkt, open shopping Sunday, Erntedankfest (harvest festival), an automobile exhibition and free concerts. The whole centre turns into a festive mile of food, stalls and entertainment for the whole family.

events.title: Gießener Herbstmesse
events.description: Gießen's traditional autumn fair (26 Sep - 4 Oct) at the Messeplatz an der Ringallee is a colourful Kirmes park with rousing rides, sweet treats, festival tent and family fun, including fireworks. A regional highlight for all ages.

events.title: Burgfestspiele auf der Ronneburg (Mittelalter)
events.description: The Burgfestspiele on the Ronneburg (26-27 Sep) turn the medieval hilltop castle into a lively festival with knights, jugglers, musicians and a special children's programme. An immersive trip back to the Middle Ages in the Wetterau countryside.

events.title: Wiesbadener Herbstmarkt-Nachklang & Weinsommer-Wochenende
events.description: Final day of the Wiesbadener Stadtfest (25-27 Sep) features the Herbstmarkt, open shopping Sunday and harvest festival with free concerts in the city centre. A relaxed closing Sunday of the big autumn weekend.

events.title: Gießener Herbstmesse – Mittelwoche & Familienprogramm
events.description: The 2026 Gießener Herbstmesse (26 Sep - 4 Oct) enters its middle week at the Messeplatz an der Ringallee, with family-friendly rides and attractions building toward the closing fireworks. A colourful Kirmes highlight of the region.

events.title: documenta/Museum Fridericianum Kassel – Mohammed Sami 'Hostless' (Eröffnung)
events.description: The Fridericianum in Kassel opens its new autumn exhibition cycle with Iraqi-British artist Mohammed Sami's 'Hostless', a series of paintings exploring interior spaces and memory. The vernissage weekend begins 2 October; a documenta-programme highlight in the run-up to documenta 16.

events.title: Marburger Elisabethmarkt
events.description: Marburg's big autumn city festival (10-11 Oct) under the motto 'Goldener Herbst': a regional market around the Elisabethkirche, a creatives' market on the Steinweg, plus family and social market stalls fill the picturesque old town with colour, craft and local food.

events.title: Marburger Elisabethmarkt – Kleinkunst & Familienprogramm
events.description: The second day of the Marburger Elisabethmarkt (10-11 Oct) features street performance and a family programme beside the regional craft and social markets around the Elisabethkirche. Golden-autumn atmosphere fills the old town.

events.title: Gallusmarkt Wetzlar
events.description: Wetzlar's traditional autumn folk festival (15-18 Oct) turns the inner city from the historic old town through Langgasse to the Bahnhofstraße into a continuous festival mile with around 150 market stalls, live stages at Haarpalatz, Eisenmarkt and the Lahn island, plus an open shopping Sunday.

events.title: Limburger Oktoberfest
events.description: The 76th Limburger Oktoberfest (15-19 Oct) with the motto 'Gipfelglück' is the region's largest folk festival. A big festival tent at the Markthalle square serves Bavarian beer and music alongside a Ferris wheel, dodgems and ghost train for family entertainment.

events.title: Gallusmarkt Wetzlar – Herbstfest-Meile (Wochenende)
events.description: The Gallusmarkt weekend (15-18 Oct) showcases Wetzlar's autumn festival mile at its fullest: around 150 market stalls, live stages at Haarplatz, Eisenmarkt and the Lahn island, plus an open shopping Sunday. Historic half-timbered streets frame the fair.

events.title: Limburger Oktoberfest – Trachtenumzug & Festzelttage
events.description: The heart of the 76th Limburger Oktoberfest (15-19 Oct) brings parade highlights and packed festival-tent days on the Markthalle square. Oktoberfest music, Bavarian beer and rides keep the region's largest folk festival buzzing.
